content.text: {"label":"marketing_campaign","confidence":"high","explanation":"Calls on the general queue started running well above forecast from 09:30, about 30 minutes after MKT-2026-551 went out at 09:00. That was a pre-approved personal loan email to 900,000 customers asking them to call to activate. Over the last four intervals there were 307 calls against 236 forecast, and nearly all the extra calls came under loan_enquiry (92 vs 40 expected) and new_offer_enquiry (50 vs 14). As a result, service level fell to 68% at 09:45. There is no open IT incident, absences are normal and agents on the phones are within one of plan, so this is extra demand, not a staffing problem.","evidence":[{"source":"calendar","ref_id":"MKT-2026-551","summary":"09:00 email to 900,000 customers: pre-approved personal loan offer with a 'Call us to activate' call to action, a general-queue topic."},{"source":"reason_codes","ref_id":"loan_enquiry","summary":"92 calls vs 40.1 expected (2.29x), share up from 17% to 30%."},{"source":"reason_codes","ref_id":"new_offer_enquiry","summary":"50 calls vs 14.2 expected (3.53x); other reasons at or below normal."},{"source":"metrics","ref_id":"volume","summary":"09:30-10:00 intervals +30%, +53%, +41% vs forecast (75/91/97 calls vs 57.5/59.3/69.0)."},{"source":"metrics","ref_id":"service_level","summary":"Service level dropped to 68.1% with 8 abandons at 09:45, 83.5% at 10:00."},{"source":"attendance","ref_id":"attendance_log","summary":"General queue: only 1 sick absence vs 2.2 usual; staffing within 1 agent of plan."}],"flagged_injections":[]}
